source.author: CoinCoin
source.note: Wave-1 row 3 named the Ultimate Animated Animals wolf (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). The reachable Quaternius wolf (Animal Pack Vol.2, OpenGameArt, CC0) has only Idle and Walking; this CC-BY wolf has a stronger silhouette and seven clips. Its clips are all named "Baked frames…" and were identified by eye. The howl and the crouch-and-pounce attack keep sinkAllowed: their long brush tail passes 16 and 24 cm through the ground while the feet stay planted, and lifting would float the whole wolf.
